about: An Arista C-360 holding its clients to the newer 802.11 generations (0089). 2.4 GHz allows 802.11g to 802.11ax: no 802.11b, so legacy_rates goes; its short guard interval is off, short_gi_20 to _160 '0'. 5 GHz allows 802.11ac and 802.11ax at 80 MHz, so require_mode is ac. 6 GHz allows 802.11ax, which it requires anyway. The 802.11ax guard intervals, 1.6, 0.8 and 3.2 microseconds, go in the agent's gi section, which aeolus-gi sets with iw. The scan radio, radio2, is left alone (0081).
